item.title: Kansas City Chiefs close to leaving Arrowhead Stadium for new home in Kansas
item.description: The Kansas City Chiefs are in talks with the state of Kansas to build a new stadium in Kansas City, Kansas, with the help of STAR bonds, while the Kansas City Royals are considering a move to Overland Park, Kansas.
